tldr: Balance sheet totals and sync status come from caches. Syncs update family timestamps. Sidebar sync indicators no longer block the page.
goal: The accounts sidebar repeats slow balance sheet queries and shows intrusive sync states.

story.heading: Balance sheet is split into value objects
story.body: BalanceSheet::AccountTotals caches the account totals. ClassificationGroup and AccountGroup hold the asset and liability groups.

story.heading: Sync touches family timestamps on each transition
story.body: Each sync transition touches family.latest_sync_activity_at. Completion touches family.latest_sync_completed_at.

story.heading: Account loses its syncing check
story.body: Account drops its syncing? method. Sync state moves to the balance sheet classes, such as SyncStatusMonitor.

story.heading: Family stores sync timestamps as cache inputs
story.body: Family stores latest_sync_activity_at and latest_sync_completed_at. Balance sheet cache keys read them.

story.heading: Sidebar shows sync state without blocking the page
story.body: Views read BalanceSheet groups and their DOM ids. The sidebar shows a sync indicator, and sync no longer blocks the page.

story.heading: Sparkline show resolves accounts before charting
story.body: The show action resolves accountable and account_ids. It then builds the chart series with Balance::ChartSeriesBuilder.

story.heading: Families table gains two sync timestamp columns
story.body: A migration adds two timestamp columns to families. The balance sheet cache reads them.

story.heading: Balance sheet cache resets on each sync
story.body: Syncs touch family timestamps. Cached balance sheet totals refresh only when a sync changes them.

components.summary: Renders sidebar groups from balance sheet value objects, with a non-blocking sync indicator.
Sparkline controller resolves accountable and account_ids, then builds the chart series.
Stores latest_sync_activity_at and latest_sync_completed_at, the cache inputs for balance sheet totals.
Drops its syncing? method; sync state moves to the balance sheet classes.
Caches account totals in AccountTotals and groups them into ClassificationGroup and AccountGroup.
The balance sheet function calls assets and liabilities instead of total_assets and total_liabilities.
Touches family timestamps on each transition and completion, and reports warnings at start.
Drops PlaidItem#syncing?, the query that checked visible syncs for each item.
Adds a migration with two timestamp columns on families.

decisions.title: Cache account totals until a sync changes them
decisions.why: The sidebar reruns costly balance sheet queries on each load. The cache keeps totals until a sync changes them.

decisions.title: Split BalanceSheet into value objects
decisions.why: Each group owns its total and DOM id. Views and the broadcaster ask the object instead of building strings.

decisions.title: Cache sync status until a sync event changes it
decisions.why: Sync indicators must not block the page. A cache keeps the monitor's answer until a sync event changes it.
